# Shape library
This is a local art library. Original source images live under library/ and reference-assets/. The renders/ folder holds an old two-image preview, not the full library. Names in catalog.csv are the artist's labels. Files with identical bytes are alternate copies, not distinct artwork. Motion JSON describes animation timing rather than an image. No installs, external services, commits or publishing are needed.
